MapProperties.MapDescription: The melee ruleset: one hero, buildings that raise an army from their mana, relics bought at the Nexus, and a Nexus to break. Terrain and models are composed from a sub-archive.
MapProperties.Author: Realm
MapProperties.HowToPlayInstructions: Your hero is the only unit you command. Begin Construction places a construction site for 100 wood and draws three buildings from the shared deck into the command grid of your hero and Nexus: pick one, then right-click the site to raise it. A raised building produces soldiers automatically from its mana, with every soldier matching your hero's level. Spend gold at your Nexus on relics.

Units.Name: Vale, the Lineholder
Units.Description: Durable frontline commander. Innate Unbroken: Vale and every owned unit carry +6 armor and +10% tenacity, always active.

Units.Name: Sable, the Ashcaller
Units.Description: Ranged area-damage spellcaster. Innate Cinder Mark: Sable's abilities and every owned unit's attacks burn for 6 magic damage a second for 2 seconds.

Units.Name: Corvus, the Quartermaster
Units.Description: Economy and tempo strategist. Innate Standing Ledger: every owned soldier-granting building stores one more production worth of mana, always active.

Units.Name: Crest Boar
Units.Description: A territorial boar that guards the woodland paths. Killing it pays gold and experience to the team that lands the blow, and it returns after 45 seconds so the camp is worth contesting again.

Units.Name: Ridge Giant
Units.Description: A slow boss that holds the middle of the board. Its bounty is worth a fight, and it returns after two minutes.

Units.Name: Worker
Units.Description: A worker raised by a building. It attacks a node of its assigned resource, and the damage that lands is turned into pieces of wood or gold carried in its inventory until it is delivered.

Buildings.Name: Construction Site
Buildings.Description: A site that has not been committed to a building yet. Every player can select it to read the buildings its owner has reserved for it.

Resources.Name: Gold Mine
Resources.Description: A finite gold node. Its capacity is its health, its resistances decide how much of a worker's hit lands, and it gives up one piece of gold for every four points that get through.

Resources.Name: Woodland
Resources.Description: A finite wood node. Its capacity is its health, its resistances decide how much of a worker's hit lands, and it gives up one piece of wood for every four points that get through.

Abilities.Name: Unbroken
Abilities.Description: Vale and every owned unit carry +6 armor and +10% tenacity while Vale lives. Always active; never cast or toggled.

Abilities.Name: Cinder Mark
Abilities.Description: Sable's abilities and every owned unit's attacks burn their target for 6 magic damage a second for 2 seconds. Always active; never cast or toggled.

Abilities.Name: Standing Ledger
Abilities.Description: Every owned soldier-granting building stores one more production worth of mana. Always active; never cast or toggled.

Abilities.Name: Grounding Shout
Abilities.Description: 60 magic damage in radius 4, rising to 120 with level, and a 25% movement slow for 2 seconds.

Abilities.Name: Hold Fast
Abilities.Description: Allies in radius 6 gain +4 armor for 3 seconds, rising to 4 seconds with level.

Abilities.Name: Shield Bash
Abilities.Description: 40 physical damage and a 1.25 second stun to a single enemy in reach, rising to 1.55 seconds with level.

Abilities.Name: Ember Lance
Abilities.Description: 90 magic damage along a line of length 12 and 35 degrees, up to 5 targets, rising to 170 with level.

Abilities.Name: Cinderfield
Abilities.Description: Ground area of radius 5 for 4 seconds, dealing 25 magic damage per second, rising to 5 seconds with level.

Abilities.Name: Backdraft
Abilities.Description: 70 magic damage and 3 units of knockback in radius 4, rising to 120 damage with level.

Abilities.Name: Requisition
Abilities.Description: Completes 30% of the hero's active construction's remaining time, rising to 50% with level.

Abilities.Name: Forced March
Abilities.Description: Allies in radius 8 gain 20% movement speed for 5 seconds.

Abilities.Name: Emergency Levy
Abilities.Description: Every owned soldier-granting building gains one production worth of mana, up to its maximum.

Abilities.Name: Mend
Abilities.Description: Auto-cast: heals the most wounded nearby ally for 22.

Abilities.Name: Warding Aegis
Abilities.Description: Auto-cast: shields the lowest-health nearby ally for 60 points for 8 seconds.

Abilities.Name: Standard Aura
Abilities.Description: Every nearby ally carries 10% more movement speed.

Abilities.Name: Begin Construction
Abilities.Description: Costs 100 wood. Place an unidentified site from the silhouette, then pick one of the buildings the shared deck draws for it; the site becomes that building and is raised by right-clicking it.

Abilities.Name: Gather
Abilities.Description: Sends this unit to work the nearest tree or gold mine. A worker keeps gathering on its own; a hero only gathers when given this order.

Items.Name: Wood
Items.Description: A piece of harvested wood. Each slot holds one, so a full inventory is six pieces.

Items.Name: Gold
Items.Description: A piece of mined gold. Each slot holds six, so a full inventory is thirty-six pieces.

Items.Name: Spiked Barricades

Items.Name: Deep Granaries
Items.Description: Workers gain 10% attack, so their gathering swings harder.
